autodeskLayerSchema.finding: Group 70 bit 16 marks an xref-dependent layer, bit 32 records a successfully resolved dependency, and Autodesk specifies the DXF linetype for xref-dependent layers as CONTINUOUS.

implementation.change: writeLayer emits CONTINUOUS for group 6 when layer flag bit 16 is set, for both pre-R13 uppercase output and later UTF-8 output. The caller's DRW_Layer remains unchanged.

focusedTest.coverage: Generated xref-dependent LAYER records with a non-CONTINUOUS input linetype pass ASCII and Binary write/readback at AC1009, AC1014, AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032. Readback checks group-70 flag 16 and group-6 CONTINUOUS.

limits: The generated profile and libdxfrw self-readback establish codec output only; no independent DXF reader or native application was run.
The source layer xrefBlockHandle and external block graph are not resolved or emitted by this bounded normalization.
No assertion is made about native xref load, display, or save behavior.
